method: Independent read-only source/diff/test/evidence review; no duplicate CLI tests, builds or application traffic.
findings: Required paths are a coverage requirement; only exact manifest-required historical diagnostic/static public asset paths may extend the usual selection.
Required hashes are matched to streamed copied-byte hashes after the temporary ZIP itself passes CRC and SHA verification, before atomic replacement.
Prior outputs are preserved on observed omitted/mismatched/private-path/input failures; temporary cleanup remains in finally.
Tests exercise the actual CLI and reopened archives; private helper return values are not outcome oracles.

Twelve methods pass in the frozen CLI log. New-option absence failures are correctly separate from three legacy wrong-success observations and the later genuine static-browser-asset refusal regression.
Current original392-input packaging is correctly refused because five historical diagnostic files are absent; the fix does not recreate them.
limits: Completeness is relative to a trusted independently reviewed supplied manifest. An incomplete or changed manifest cannot certify unavailable source parity.
The option is opt-in; calls without it report checked=false and must not claim accepted canonical coverage.
Path allow/deny rules do not inspect arbitrary file contents for secrets. Exact selection, reviewed manifests/evidence and existing privacy review remain required.
The archived checkpoint helper was not modified by this patch. Future checkpoint assembly must invoke the new coverage check or an equivalent independently enforced gate.
Existing symlink checks and O_NOFOLLOW are preserved; this is not a claim of a hostile concurrent-filesystem race-proof sandbox.
No fresh full project gate, missing-diagnostic recovery, new archive delivery or performance qualification was established.
